dataset: NIH ChestX-ray14 (public), patient-level splits by Member A

selection.why: Member A's README names it the frozen model. Its MANIFEST checksums match the files, its model_version is reproduced from backbone.json + head.npz + policy.json, policy.json was fitted for this head.npz, and every prediction row carries this version. On the same 21,845 held-out NIH test images it beats v1 on every finding.

rejected.artifacts_v1_imagenet_frozen: same backbone, head trained on a 30,000-image subset; lower AUROC on every finding
rejected.artifacts: intermediate working copy, identical to v1 (same model_version); not used by any report

splits.rule: thresholds and the sensitivity floor use the validation split only; the test split is reported, never tuned on

default_threshold.method: Member B's select_threshold_at_sensitivity on the validation split, snapped down to the 0.01 percentile grid

demo.seed_selection: 12 demo images chosen so that raised, unsure, normal and out-of-distribution scans are all visible at the default threshold; not a performance sample

licence_note: NIH ChestX-ray14 images and labels are public (NIH Clinical Center; cite Wang et al. 2017). CheXpert rows and images are excluded: its research-use agreement forbids redistribution.
